title: Performance Monitor Unable to Monitor Virtual Network Interfaces

judgment.rationale: Reuse PR #51596 for both Performance Monitor and Dock network statistics. The discussion resolved the hardware-counter question; do not ask for network logs or promise this is shipped.
evidence: The author supplied Get-NetAdapter metadata and confirmed Windows Performance Monitor also shows zero on the hardware adapter while the virtual interface carries traffic.
